# Fixtures

Recorded and synthetic event streams used by adapter and core tests (PRD §19.1).

- `synthetic/` — hand-written streams (added in Phase 1).
- `<host>/` — streams recorded from real host sessions (added in Phase 3 for the first adapter).

Fixture format and loader are specified in the Phase 1 plan:
`docs/plans/02-phase-1-contract-and-core.md` (Task 1.17).
